selectedFunctions.label: Capricorn Deposit (aprMON)
warnings: Static source/ABI admission only, not fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity, current pause/fee/delay state or successful-execution guarantee. Canonical calldata, grants, pause overlays and independent execution controls remain mandatory.

Capricorn is the current official brand of former aPriori: apr.io redirects to capricorn.tech, the staking app and official integration docs retain the same aprMON mainnet proxy. This is one protocol, not a new rebrand count or the separate Capricorn exchange. Only Monad mainnet chain143 is admitted, not testnet/Sepolia lookalikes.

Upgradeable aprMON proxy 0x0c65A0BC65a5D819235B71F554D210D3F80E0852 is bound by Monadscan to current reported implementation 0x7D2F8dc5a67CA1911bb1A2429552CDf507d106F2. Upgrades and owner-selected oracle, staking precompile, validators and fee vault can change behavior; no persistence assertion.

Underlying is native MON (18-decimal wei), represented by Eeeee native-asset sentinel, not WMON/ERC20. deposit requires msg.value exactly equal assets and assets strictly greater than 1000000000 wei; issues non-rebasing aprMON shares to receiver. mint rounds required native assets upward, requires msg.value >= assets, and refunds surplus to caller with an empty-data native call which can revert if caller rejects it. No underlying approval is needed.

requestRedeem moves owner aprMON shares into vault escrow and snapshots MON assets; it does not pay MON. Caller must be owner or an already authorized owner operator; ERC20 allowance alone is insufficient. Controller receives claim authority and need not equal owner; choose intentionally. MinimumRedeem is measured in MON asset wei; each controller has a bounded request-slot array.

redeem takes request IDs, not a share quantity; caller must be controller or its preauthorized operator while unpaused. When paused only oracleOperator can redeem, so user exits can be frozen. Each batch must already be oracle processed after staking/precompile unlock epochs; wall-clock estimates are not guaranteed and no cancellation function is present. Nonpayable requestRedeem/redeem require zero native value.

Withdrawal fee is charged at claim using then-current owner-configured withdrawalFee / 10000, including on existing requests; setter allows up to 10000 (100%). Reward fee uses percent denominator100 and is owner mutable. No caller-set min shares, max fee, min net redemption or deadline exists. Native receiver payout uses empty calldata and can revert; all IDs in one redeem are atomic.

previewWithdraw/maxWithdraw getters do not establish a synchronous withdraw function or immediately available liquidity. Conversion uses totalSupply minus burnableShares and oracle/staking accounting; floor/ceiling rounding and stale/ordered oracle updates affect amounts. No backing, rewards, valuation, liquidity, validator performance or financial-safety guarantee.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: Official apr.io redirects to current Capricorn Tech website, whose Stake Now link points to app.capricorn.tech.
Current official docs describe liquid staking aprMON as one of the two synergistic current pillars of Capricorn Tech.

Current official integration page publishes mainnet aprMON deployment and full interface; current official app presents stake/unstake product. No exit-only, retirement or shutdown notice observed in reviewed primary sources.

sourceSemantics.units: Native MON wei and aprMON ERC20 share base units, both 18 decimals. asset() returns 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE sentinel.
sourceSemantics.deposit: assets > DUST_THRESHOLD (1e9), msg.value==assets; convertToShares floors; zero shares rejected; increments totalPendingDeposit and mints receiver shares whenNotPaused.
sourceSemantics.mint: _convertToAssets(shares,Ceil), assets>1e9 and msg.value>=assets, increments pending deposit, mints shares, refunds excess native to caller with empty calldata.
sourceSemantics.requestRedeem: owner or existing owner operator only (not allowance); snapshot current floor converted assets >= minimumRedeem, store request under chosen controller, move shares from owner to vault; return ID. Cannot cancel via this ABI.
sourceSemantics.redeem: Loop exact request IDs. Valid unclaimed request, caller controller/operator when not paused; oracleOperator only during pause. Batch<=lastProcessedWithdrawalBatchId required. Burn escrow shares and subtract burnableShares; apply current withdrawalFee/10000 to snapshotted assets; pay receiver native via empty calldata; failure reverts entire transaction.
sourceSemantics.asyncSettlement: Oracle-operated ordered claimValidatorRewards/processDepositsAndWithdrawals/updateOracleData processing interacts with owner-configured staking precompile, assigns unlock epochs and moves lastProcessedWithdrawalBatchId after _processWithdrawals. Merely passing a wall-clock delay is insufficient.
sourceSemantics.fees: Withdrawal basis points up to10000 (100%) and rewardFee percent up to100 are owner mutable. Existing requests use fee at claim, not request.
sourceSemantics.opaqueExecution: No selected function contains bytes or caller-supplied downstream target/calldata. Native mint refund/redeem payout calls have empty calldata only; no executor or callback capability admitted.
sourceSemantics.eligibility: No explicit investor KYC gate appears in selected implementation functions; protocol terms, owner pause and operational permissions remain independent. No live eligibility assertion.

limitations: Static source/ABI admission only, not fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity, current pause/fee/delay state or successful-execution guarantee. Canonical calldata, grants, pause overlays and independent execution controls remain mandatory.
